0.0: Hey there. I'm #p2151004#. I head up the Resistance Mechanic division. I'm sort of a gearhead, so I was hoping to get a look at #bwhat you can do#k. Hope you don't mind...

yes.0: Can't wait to see what you've got. There's a portal to your left. Take that hallway down to the #b#m310010100##k and take out #b30#k of the #b#o9300409##k decoys I built. They've got a nasty little cloaking defense I built in, but I'm sure you can take them down with the right timing.

no.0: No? Need me to make some repairs?

1.0: Hmm, your systems sure aren't running at full speed right now. That control device Gelimer had on you must've been managing your implants. How do you feel?\r\n#L0##bWeaker, but the tests at the lab were much more difficult.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh yeah?\r\n#L0##bI was often thrown into battle against much larger opponents, some with herculean strength.#l\n#k
1.2: Huh... you must've been quite a fighter. Too bad all that power's gone now.\r\n#L0##bThat power made me one of Gelimer's pawns. It was a leash.#l\n#k
1.3: Yeah, I could see that when you came in here trying to wreck the place. Glad you managed to get yourself free.

yes.0: Look at me prattling on like an old hen. You're one of us now. I've gotta give you a proper welcome. Here's a little something I give to the new recruits.

mob.0: You still haven't smashed #b30#k of those #b#o9300409##k decoys? Take the portal to the left then you'll see another portal next to a big fella named #bElex#k. Head into the #b#m310010100##k and you'll find the #b#o9300409##k monsters on the 2nd basement floor.
